10 Principles - "Present Yourself as a Man in Full."

for my younger self. slim chance he'd have gotten it.

1. The collective judgment of humanity will get you right. Your faith in this principle must never be shaken.

2. Those who matter will get you right, as will the fat part of the curve. Tails and edge cases are noise.

3. Treat the wisdom of crowds as gospel and trust that the crowd, in all its forms, will get u for who u are

4. But for this to happen, it is incumbent on you to always "present yourself as a man in full."

5. Be who you are. Be comfortable in your own skin.

6. Do not paint a picture or apply gloss. Do not think.

7. Let the crowd observe you from every angle, the good and the bad, and get comfortable with what they see.

8. Over time, perfect alignment will be achieved between their image of you, and who you actually are.

9. Never get defensive. The wise man, the crowd, they see all. They recognize envy as envy and slander as slander, because he is familiar to them just as you are.

10. Most important: HAVE FAITH IN HUMANITY.

That last one, 10, is the one that cannot be taught or read in a book. I didn't have it when I was younger.

END: THE ACQUISITION OF FAITH

You acquire it by spending time with ALL humans around the world, high, low, rich, poor, black, white.

It is only when you have seen man in all his forms -- man, as "a man in full" -- that you reach your own perfect alignment. 

All men are the exact same, human nature is the exact same, and all have hopes and dreams and are proud and desire glory.  
  
The lie you were told -- that you will encounter some who are "different," -- lays shattered on the ground, replaced by a warmth towards your fellow man. 

There has never been a human heart without some measure of love, a desire to do good and achieve glory and be known to his family as a hero. 

You laugh at thinking it could have ever been otherwise, that God has ever created a human being that was unlike those before it or those to come. Human nature, and the minds and hearts that comprise it, has never deviated throughout recorded history. 

In this process, you acquire the unshakable faith that no matter where you go, or who you encounter, every single man you meet will be the same as every single man you have met. 

It has never been any other way. It never will be. As with all things, it exists in perfect alignment under God.

quotedTweet.text: “Human nature is the same all over the world; but its operations are so varied by education and habit, that one must see it in all its dresses in order to be intimately acquainted with it.” Chesterfield
